description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of different configurations of the LLaMA model in solving math word problems, as measured by the CoLaGeR metric. The vertical axis represents the CoLaGeR percentage, ranging from 0 to 80, while the horizontal axis lists three different model configurations: LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B. Each configuration is further divided into four categories based on the presence and type of self-feeding training (SFT): no SFT, SFT on D0, SFT on D0 and D1, and SFT on D0, D1, and D2. The bars are color-coded and patterned to distinguish between the categories, with no SFT represented by a blue bar with diagonal stripes, SFT on D0 by a yellow bar with diagonal stripes, SFT on D0 and D1 by a red bar with diagonal stripes, and SFT on D0, D1, and D2 by a purple bar with diagonal stripes. The chart shows that the performance of all configurations is relatively high, with the highest CoLaGeR percentages observed in the LLaMA-2-70B configuration with SFT on D0, D1, and D2. The values for each bar are not explicitly provided, but the chart indicates that the performance generally increases with the addition of SFT, with the most significant improvement seen in the LLaMA-2-70B configuration.
